For sign-off between stages, run each stage as its own workflow</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">No direct filesystem or shell access from the workflow itself</td><td style="text-align:left">Agents read, write, and run commands. The script coordinates the agents</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">No module loading: a script that contains <code>import()</code> fails before the run starts</td><td style="text-align:left">The script body is plain JavaScript. Put work that needs a library in an agent’s task</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">Up to 16 concurrent agents, fewer when Claude Code has fewer CPUs available, including inside a CPU-limited container</td><td style="text-align:left">Bounds local resource use</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">In a fan-out, agents that share the first agent’s prompt-cache prefix start up to 5 seconds after it by default</td><td style="text-align:left">All but the first read the <a class="link" href="#prompt-caching-in-a-fan-out">prefix the first agent cached</a> instead of each processing it uncached</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">1,000 agents total per run</td><td style="text-align:left">Prevents runaway loops</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="manage-runs"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#manage-runs">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Manage runs</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Once a run starts, you manage it from the <code>/workflows</code> view, or by expanding its progress line in the task panel below the input box.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="resume-after-a-pause"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#resume-after-a-pause">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Resume after a pause</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">If you stop a run, you can resume it. Agents that already completed usually return their cached results, and the rest run live.</span>
<span data-as="p">Two rules decide which results survive:</span>
<ul>
<li>An agent that was still running when you stopped isn’t saved, so it starts over on resume.</li>
<li>Replay follows the order agents started. Cached results stop at the first agent that didn’t finish, and every agent that started after that one runs again, even if it completed.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The second rule is what makes stopping mid fan-out expensive. Say a script starts four agents, A, B, C, and D, in that order, and you stop the run while B is still going. On resume, A returns from cache. B runs again because it never finished. C and D run again too, because they started after B, even though both completed before you stopped.</span>
<span data-as="p">A workflow that fans work out across many small agents therefore preserves more progress than one long agent.</span>
<span data-as="p">Resume a paused run from <code>/workflows</code> by selecting it and pressing <code>p</code>, or ask Claude to relaunch the workflow with the same script.</span>
<span data-as="p">Resume works within the same Claude Code session. If you exit Claude Code while a workflow is running, the next session starts the workflow fresh.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="cost"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#cost">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Cost</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A workflow spawns many agents, so a single run can use meaningfully more tokens than working through the same task in conversation. Runs count toward your plan’s usage and rate limits like any other session.</span>
<span data-as="p">To gauge the spend before committing to a large task, run the workflow on a small slice first: one directory instead of the whole repo, or a narrow question instead of a broad one. The <code>/workflows</code> view shows each agent’s token usage as the run progresses, and you can stop the run there at any time, usually without losing completed work. <a class="link" href="#resume-after-a-pause">Resume after a pause</a> covers what a stopped run keeps. The runtime’s <a class="link" href="#behavior-and-limits">agent caps</a> limit how many agents a single run can spawn, which bounds the cost of a runaway script. To keep runs to fewer agents, choose the <code>small</code> <a class="link" href="#set-a-size-guideline">size guideline</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code also flags a run that grows unusually large. When a workflow schedules more than 25 agents, or its projected token total passes 1.5 million, its progress line in the task panel below the input box shows a <code>Large workflow</code> warning. The warning points you to <a class="link" href="#watch-the-run"><code>/workflows</code></a>, where you can stop the run.</span>
<span data-as="p">The warning is advisory: it doesn’t pause or limit the run. Two settings change when you see it:</span>
<ul>
<li>If you choose a <a class="link" href="#set-a-size-guideline">size guideline</a> yourself, its agent count replaces the 25-agent threshold. The built-in default guideline leaves the threshold at 25.</li>
<li>Sessions with <a class="link" href="#let-claude-decide-with-ultracode">ultracode</a> on don’t show the warning, because turning ultracode on already opts you in to large runs.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Every agent in a workflow uses your session’s model unless the script routes a stage to a different one or the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#environment-variables"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL</code></a> environment variable is set, which overrides both. To control the model cost:</span>
<ul>
<li>Check <code>/model</code> before a large run if you usually switch to a smaller model for routine work</li>
<li>Ask Claude to use a smaller model for stages that don’t need the strongest one when you describe the task</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">When your organization’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#restrict-model-selection"><code>availableModels</code> allowlist</a> blocks a model the script requests for an agent, that agent runs on a substituted model instead, following the same <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#choose-a-model">substitution rules as subagents</a>. The run’s progress view in <a class="link" href="#watch-the-run"><code>/workflows</code></a> shows a warning naming both the requested and substituted models.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="set-a-size-guideline"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#set-a-size-guideline">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Set a size guideline</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A size guideline tells Claude how many agents to aim for when it writes a dynamic workflow. Claude Code sends the guideline to Claude as advice, not a cap, so a prompt that calls for a different scale still overrides it. Requires Claude Code v2.1.202 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p">Each value maps to an agent count:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_10kllktbsnlhjiuasnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px] [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Value</th><th style="text-align:left">Agent count Claude aims for</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>unrestricted</code></td><td style="text-align:left">No guideline: Claude sizes the workflow to the task</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>small</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Fewer than 5 agents</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>medium</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Fewer than 15 agents</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>large</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Fewer than 50 agents</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">The default is <code>medium</code>. Until you choose a value, the <code>/config</code> row shows <code>medium (default)</code> and the workflow’s <code>Running in background</code> line shows <code>medium size (/config)</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later; earlier versions default to <code>unrestricted</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">To change the guideline, pick a value for the Dynamic workflow size setting in <code>/config</code>, or run <code>/config workflowSizeGuideline=small</code>. On v2.1.219 and later, you can also set the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#workflowsizeguideline"><code>workflowSizeGuideline</code> key</a> in any settings file; that value takes precedence over <code>/config</code>, and Claude Code hides the <code>/config</code> row while a settings file provides one.</span>
<span data-as="p">Changes take effect on the next prompt. The <a class="link" href="#behavior-and-limits">runtime agent caps</a> still apply regardless of the setting.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="turn-workflows-off"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#turn-workflows-off">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Turn workflows off</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Workflows are available in the CLI, the Desktop app, the IDE extensions, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/headless">non-interactive mode</a> with <code>claude -p</code>, and the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview">Agent SDK</a>. The same disable settings apply on every surface.</span>
<span data-as="p">To turn workflows off for yourself:</span>
<ul>
<li>Toggle Dynamic workflows off in <code>/config</code>. Persists across sessions.</li>
<li>Set <code>"disableWorkflows": true</code> in <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>. Persists across sessions.</li>
<li>Set <code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1</code>. Read at startup, so it applies wherever you set it.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">To turn workflows off for your whole organization, set <code>"disableWorkflows": true</code> in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/server-managed-settings">managed settings</a>, or use the toggle on the <a class="link" href="https://claude.ai/admin-settings/claude-code" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Claude Code admin settings</a> page.</span>
<span data-as="p">When workflows are disabled, the bundled workflow commands are unavailable, the <code>ultracode</code> keyword no longer triggers a run, and <code>ultracode</code> is removed from the <code>/effort</code> menu.</span>

--toc-btn-size: 1.75rem; /* ours, not mirrored: the toggle's diameter */\n}\n\n/* Hidden by default: below the xl breakpoint Mintlify hides the ToC\n   anyway, and pages that render no ToC (wide-mode its 2.5rem left-padding\n     strip: at the column's left edge, minus the button's own width and\n     a small gap. 100% rather than 100vw so a classic scrollbar doesn't\n     shift the math (percentages on fixed elements resolve against the\n     layout viewport). */\n  right: calc(\n    max((100% - var(--toc-wrapper-max)) / 2, 0px) + var(--toc-wrapper-pad) +\n      var(--toc-col) - var(--toc-btn-size) - 0.35rem\n  );\n  transition: right 200ms ease-out;\n  z-index: 30;\n  width: var(--toc-btn-size);\n  height: var(--toc-btn-size);\n  border-radius: 9999px;\n  border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border-300) / 0.15);\n  background: hsl(var(--bg-100));\n  color: hsl(var(--text-400));\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n#toc-collapse-toggle:hover {\n  background: hsl(var(--bg-300));\n  color: round;\n}\n\n/* The list glyph only appears while the button is parked at the right\n   edge, so the collapsed control still reads as the table of contents. */\n#toc-collapse-toggle .toc-glyph {\n  display: none;\n  stroke-width: 2;\n}\n\n/* A fixed-position button would repeat on every printed page. */\n@media print {\n  #toc-collapse-toggle {\n    display: none !important;\n  }\n}\n\n@media flex;\n  }\n\n  html.toc-collapsed #toc-collapse-toggle .toc-chevron {\n    transform: rotate(180deg);\n  }\n\n  /* The column is gone while collapsed, so the button moves to the\n     right edge padding: 0 0.5rem;\n    gap: 0.25rem;\n  }\n\n  html.toc-collapsed #toc-collapse-toggle .toc-glyph {\n    display: block;\n  }\n\n  html.toc-collapsed #table-of-contents-layout {\n    display: none runs`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`The workflow runtime executes the script in an isolated environment, separate from your conversation. Intermediate results stay in script variables instead of landing in Claude’s context.`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Every run writes its script to a file under your session’s directory in `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`~/.claude/projects/`}),`. Claude receives the path when the run starts, so you can ask for it. You can open that file to read the orchestration Claude wrote, diff it against a previous run’s script, or edit it and ask Claude to relaunch from the edited version.`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`The runtime tracks each agent’s result as the run progresses, which is what makes a run `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#resume-after-a-pause`,children:`resumable`}),` within the same session.`]}),`\n`,_jsx(Heading,{level:`3`,id:`prompt-caching-in-a-fan-out`,children:`Prompt caching in a fan-out`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Agents in the same run can read each other’s `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/prompt-caching#subagents-and-the-cache`,children:`prompt cache`}),`. Two agents that run with the same model, effort level, agent type, tools, output schema, and working directory build the same tools-and-system-prompt prefix, so an agent that starts after a matching sibling’s response has begun reads that sibling’s cache on its first request.`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`A workflow agent’s requests fall outside the main conversation’s `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/prompt-caching#which-ttl-each-request-gets`,children:`cache TTL bucket`}),`, so its cache holds for five minutes by default, including on a Claude subscription. To keep it for an hour, set `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/settings-reference#subagentpromptcachettl`,children:_jsx(_components.code,{children:`subagentPromptCacheTtl`})}),` to `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`1h`}),`. The API bills 1-hour cache writes at a higher rate.`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`When a fan-out starts several matching agents at once, Claude Code holds all but the first until the first agent’s response begins, then releases the held agents together so their first requests read the shared prefix instead of each processing it uncached. Claude Code caps the hold at `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/env-vars`,children:_jsx(_components.code,{children:`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS`})}),` milliseconds, `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`5000`}),` by default. Set it to `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`0`}),` to disable the hold.`]}),`\n`,_jsx(Heading,{level:`3`,id:`behavior-and-limits`,children:`Behavior and limits`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`The runtime applies the following constraints:`}),`\n`,_jsxs(Table,{children:[_jsx(_components.thead,{children:_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.th,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Constraint`}),_jsx(_components.th,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Why`})]})}),_jsxs(_components.tbody,{children:[_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`No mid-run user input`}),_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Only agent permission prompts can pause a run. For sign-off between stages, run each stage as its own workflow`})]}),_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`No direct filesystem or shell access from the workflow itself`}),_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Agents read, write, and run commands. The script coordinates the agents`})]}),_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsxs(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:[`No module loading: a script that contains `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`import()`}),` fails before the run starts`]}),_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`The script body is plain JavaScript. Put work that needs a library in an agent’s task`})]}),_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Up to 16 concurrent agents, fewer when Claude Code has fewer CPUs available, including inside a CPU-limited container`}),_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Bounds local resource use`})]}),_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`In a fan-out, agents that share the first agent’s prompt-cache prefix start up to 5 seconds after it by default`}),_jsxs(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:[`All but the first read the `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#prompt-caching-in-a-fan-out`,children:`prefix the first agent cached`}),` instead of each processing it uncached`]})]}),_jsxs(_components.tr,{children:[_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`1,000 agents total per run`}),_jsx(_components.td,{style:{textAlign:`left`},children:`Prevents runaway loops`})]})]})]}),`\n`,_jsx(Heading,{level:`2`,id:`manage-runs`,children:`Manage runs`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Once a run starts, you manage it from the `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`/workflows`}),` view, or by expanding its progress line in the task panel below the input box.`]}),`\n`,_jsx(Heading,{level:`3`,id:`resume-after-a-pause`,children:`Resume after a pause`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`If you stop a run, you can resume it. Agents that already completed usually return their cached results, and the rest run live.`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`Two rules decide which results survive:`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.ul,{children:[`\n`,_jsx(_components.li,{children:`An agent that was still running when you stopped isn’t saved, so it starts over on resume.`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.li,{children:`Replay follows the order agents started. Cached results stop at the first agent that didn’t finish, and every agent that started after that one runs again, even if it completed.`}),`\n`]}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`The second rule is what makes stopping mid fan-out expensive. Say a script starts four agents, A, B, C, and D, in that order, and you stop the run while B is still going. On resume, A returns from cache. B runs again because it never finished. C and D run again too, because they started after B, even though both completed before you stopped.`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`A workflow that fans work out across many small agents therefore preserves more progress than one long agent.`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Resume a paused run from `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`/workflows`}),` by selecting it and pressing `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`p`}),`, or ask Claude to relaunch the workflow with the same script.`]}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`Resume works within the same Claude Code session. If you exit Claude Code while a workflow is running, the next session starts the workflow fresh.`}),`\n`,_jsx(Heading,{level:`3`,id:`cost`,children:`Cost`}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`A workflow spawns many agents, so a single run can use meaningfully more tokens than working through the same task in conversation. Runs count toward your plan’s usage and rate limits like any other session.`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`To gauge the spend before committing to a large task, run the workflow on a small slice first: one directory instead of the whole repo, or a narrow question instead of a broad one. The `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`/workflows`}),` view shows each agent’s token usage as the run progresses, and you can stop the run there at any time, usually without losing completed work. `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#resume-after-a-pause`,children:`Resume after a pause`}),` covers what a stopped run keeps. The runtime’s `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#behavior-and-limits`,children:`agent caps`}),` limit how many agents a single run can spawn, which bounds the cost of a runaway script. To keep runs to fewer agents, choose the `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`small`}),` `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#set-a-size-guideline`,children:`size guideline`}),`.`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Claude Code also flags a run that grows unusually large. When a workflow schedules more than 25 agents, or its projected token total passes 1.5 million, its progress line in the task panel below the input box shows a `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`Large workflow`}),` warning. The warning points you to `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#watch-the-run`,children:_jsx(_components.code,{children:`/workflows`})}),`, where you can stop the run.`]}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.p,{children:`The warning is advisory: it doesn’t pause or limit the run. Two settings change when you see it:`}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.ul,{children:[`\n`,_jsxs(_components.li,{children:[`If you choose a `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#set-a-size-guideline`,children:`size guideline`}),` yourself, its agent count replaces the 25-agent threshold. The built-in default guideline leaves the threshold at 25.`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.li,{children:[`Sessions with `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`#let-claude-decide-with-ultracode`,children:`ultracode`}),` on don’t show the warning, because turning ultracode on already opts you in to large runs.`]}),`\n`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`Every agent in a workflow uses your session’s model unless the script routes a stage to a different one or the `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/model-config#environment-variables`,children:_jsx(_components.code,{children:`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`})}),` environment variable is set, which overrides both. To control the model cost:`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.ul,{children:[`\n`,_jsxs(_components.li,{children:[`Check `,_jsx(_components.code,{children:`/model`}),` before a large run if you usually switch to a smaller model for routine work`]}),`\n`,_jsx(_components.li,{children:`Ask Claude to use a smaller model for stages that don’t need the strongest one when you describe the task`}),`\n`]}),`\n`,_jsxs(_components.p,{children:[`When your organization’s `,_jsxs(_components.a,{href:`/en/model-config#restrict-model-selection`,children:[_jsx(_components.code,{children:`availableModels`}),` allowlist`]}),` blocks a model the script requests for an agent, that agent runs on a substituted model instead, following the same `,_jsx(_components.a,{href:`/en/sub-agents#choose-a-model`,children:`substitution rules as subagents`}),`.
